author: National Geographic
description:
Werner Herzog documents an extraordinary quest into Angola’s remote highlands, where legend tells of elephants never seen by humans. Following Dr. Steve Boyes and his team, #GhostElephants explores the fragile balance between myth, science, and the urgent need to safeguard Africa’s remaining wild spaces. 

Now streaming on @disneyplus and @hulu.

description:
Dive into the groundbreaking documentary series IN THEIR OWN WORDS featuring eyewitness, first-hand storytelling from recordings made at the time of each event. This MEGA episode features three, full episodes: 

Narco Wars In Their Own Words
In Their Own Words: Narco Wars presents the inside story of how DEA agents and the Colombian National Police brought down a vicious drug cartel.

Bernie Madoff in His Own Words
In Their Own Words: Bernie Madoff presents the story of the largest financial fraud in history as told by those who were there. 

Deepwater Horizon In Their Own Words
In Their Own Words: Deepwater Horizon presents the harrowing story of how a crew of oil rig workers escaped a massive fire in the Gulf of Mexico.
